Welcome to

War Events

A news site covering the Key Developments shaping world affairs, presented through a live, interactive globe. We're in beta — some features are still in development and will keep evolving.

01

Follow the tour

The globe auto-tours current Key Developments. Click any tick along the bottom, or a glowing marker, to jump straight there — or hit pause any time to explore freely.

02

Open any country

Click a country to pull up its full profile — population, GDP, global ranking, alliances, adversaries, trade partners, nuclear status, and UN voting record.

03

See the relationships

With a country open, use the filter bar above the globe to trace its armed conflicts, key partners, adversaries, trade flows, foreign bases, and nuclear range.
